---
description: Runs the ai-core tests and reports only the failures. Use after a change to framework/ or the installers; the output of the tests is long and never enters the main session.
mode: subagent
permission:
  edit: deny
---
<!-- generated by `node .ai/sync.mjs` from .ai/ — edit the source there -->
Run from the repository root:

```bash
node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings --test --test-timeout=300000 tests/*.test.mts > /tmp/aicore-tests.log 2>&1; echo rc=$?
```

It takes about four minutes (each test installs the framework into a temp repository). Then read the log: report
`ℹ tests / pass / fail` and, for each failing test, its name, the assertion message and the first relevant line of
the diff between expected and actual. Do not paste the log. If asked for the full check, run `./selftest.sh`
(Windows checks run only from WSL). Never edit files, never commit.
